modmenu.descriptionTranslation.gizmoclie: A client-side Minecraft mod that bundles small, configurable quality-of-life tweaks for vanilla gameplay.
gui.gizmoclienttweaks.cloth_config_warni:
Installing §lCloth Config API§r allows you to edit this mod's configuration through a graphical interface, but it doesn't appear to be installed.

Don't worry! You can still edit the %s file manually, then click the §a§lLoad Config§r button below to reload the configuration.
config.gizmoclienttweaks.remove_realms_b: Removes the Realms button from the title screen
config.gizmoclienttweaks.language_code_f: Allows searching for languages using codes like `en_US` or `enUS` in the language selection screen
config.gizmoclienttweaks.hide_fire_overl: Hides the screen fire overlay if the player has Fire Resistance or is in Creative Mode
config.gizmoclienttweaks.hide_insecure_w: Hides the toast warning that the server is not secure when joining a server
config.gizmoclienttweaks.unfocused_fps_l: Limits the frame rate when the game window is not focused.
Mutes all game audio while the game window is not focused
config.gizmoclienttweaks.client_ping_ref: How often the client refreshes its ping measurement, in seconds. Values outside 1-29 disable this feature
config.gizmoclienttweaks.ping_fps_hud.en: Shows live ping and FPS in-game, including while chat is open
config.gizmoclienttweaks.status_icons.@t: Shows icons on the HUD when the player is on fire or freezing
config.gizmoclienttweaks.status_icons.sh: Shows an icon when the player is on fire
Shows an icon when the player is freezing (ticksFrozen > 0)
config.gizmoclienttweaks.status_icons.an: HUD anchor point for the icons
config.gizmoclienttweaks.status_icons.of: Horizontal pixel offset from the anchor point
Vertical pixel offset from the anchor point
config.gizmoclienttweaks.status_icons.ic: Size of each status icon in pixels
Spacing between icons in pixels when multiple are shown
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.@t: Shows the ping value as a number in the player list instead of only the connection bars
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.en: Replaces the connection bars in the player list with the numeric ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.sh: Shows the connection icon next to the numeric ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.sl: Extra width in pixels added to each player list slot to make room for the ping value
config.gizmoclienttweaks.numeric_ping.ru: Color rules applied to the ping value. The first matching rule is used
Ping range this rule matches, e.g. `>=100 <=200`. Use `*` to match any ping
Color used for the ping value when this rule matches
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.warning: §c§lWarning:§r Only disable a Mixin if you fully understand its purpose and the consequences. Disabling a Mixin will completely disable its associated functionality and may cause unexpected behavior or compatibility issues.
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.un: Disabling these mixins disables the unfocused FPS limit and the unfocused mute, which cap the frame rate and silence all audio while the game window is not focused
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.cl: Disabling these mixins stops the client from measuring its own ping, so your entry in the player list falls back to the latency reported by the server
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.nu: Disabling these mixins removes the numeric ping value from the player list, leaving only the vanilla connection bars
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.pi: Disabling these mixins removes the live ping and FPS display, both while playing and while the chat screen is open
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.hi: Disabling these mixins stops the fire overlay from being hidden, so the first-person flames stay visible even with Fire Resistance or in Creative mode
Disabling these mixins brings back the toast warning that the server is not secure when joining a server
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.la: Disabling these mixins removes language code search from the language selection screen, so codes like `en_US` or `enUS` no longer match a language
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.re: Disabling these mixins brings the Realms button back to the title screen and restores the original button layout
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.cl: Disabling these mixins removes the tooltip positioning fix and, on Minecraft 1.21.11 and newer, the click and focus fixes for nested Cloth Config entries
config.gizmoclienttweaks.mixins.group.un: Mixins that have not been assigned to a specific feature group yet. Disabling one may affect the internal or newly added feature it belongs to
